VPL_v4.rule: F7 (natural instances, exact truth): routed optimal > best constituent optimal, routed wrong <= best constituent wrong, one-sided exact sign test over discordant held-out items p < 0.05, routed median latency <= 60 s and <= 10x the best constituent's median. Best constituent chosen on held-out results (most optimal, then fewest wrong). Practitioner, compiled-arm and per-network comparisons reported, not part of the rule. VPL = families meeting their rule.
